_about: How MTR – 03 finds the network approval letter among a deal's HubSpot attachments (file names, case-insensitive regex). Newest match wins. A note starting 'Network approval' (written by MTR – 05) is also accepted.

Ausgrid._note: Confirmed by Rodrigo 23 Sep 2026: the Notification Letter is the approval retailers need.

Endeavour._note: Same rule as the Endeavour PTC workflow

Essential._note: Rare. No file name rule yet: Essential deals hold until the letter is attached as a note starting "Network approval".
